text: Long coffee with Tanvi. Her dad passed away on Thursday and the funeral is 14 Nov at the crematorium in Harrow. She's holding it together but clearly exhausted. Her brother Hugo is flying in from Lisbon the day before. Remind me to send flowers to the house that morning.
Giulia and Darius got engaged!! He asked on the beach in Sardinia. Wedding probably next summer, they're thinking 3rd of June.
Callum's been made redundant, found out Monday. Says he's fine but he went very quiet when I asked about the mortgage. Need to check in with him the week after the consultation meeting on 28/10.

Uma and Jin's tenth anniversary is 9 March. Jin wants to do a surprise weekend in Bath and asked me to keep Uma busy that Saturday morning. Uma's been hinting she'd love a proper print of their wedding photo, so worth passing that on.
Quick catch up with Efua after church. Her nan is in hospice now, they think a couple of weeks. Efua is taking time off work.
Ciara and Elijah have split up. Ten years. She's moving back in with her mum in Galway for a bit, leaving 2 Dec. Don't forget to ring her the evening she gets there.
Picked up the suit from the tailor. Still need shoes before Saturday.
Hassan's sister Farah is getting married on 21st of December in Manchester. Big Pakistani wedding, three days of it, mehndi on the Friday. I'm driving up with Hassan on the Thursday.

Talked to Astrid on the phone for ages. Her and Aleksander have called the wedding off, it was meant to be 5 April. She seems relieved more than anything honestly. She's thinking of going travelling in the spring instead, maybe Japan.

Delroy's mum's funeral was yesterday. Really lovely service, the whole church was full. He said the next few weeks will be the hard part once everyone goes home. I should take him for a pint the week after, get him out of the house.

Zofia Nowak - new on the team, used to work at Santander. Vegetarian, has a whippet called Pickle. Getting married in Kraków on 17 August, her fiancé Carlos is Spanish so they're doing two receptions.

Barbara at book club told me her husband Chris got let go from the council last week after 22 years. They're worried about money. She asked if I knew anyone hiring in facilities management. Must ask Yaw if his firm still has that opening, before Friday.
Mila's grandad died. She's gutted, they were really close. Funeral's in Poland so she'll be away 10th-17th November.
Wiremu and Olivia celebrate 25 years married on the 30th. Silver! Party at the rugby club that night. Remind me to order the cake by the 20th and pick it up the morning of.

Santiago was nervous about his best man speech for Aurelio's wedding on 12/07. Said he's rewritten it six times. He's dreading it. Text him good luck the night before, and ask how it went the next day.
Afua's engaged to Yaw Osei. Ring is gorgeous, his grandma's. They want a small do, maybe registry office in the spring and a party afterwards.

Joanna lost her job at the agency. Third round of cuts this year. Her husband Hugo is being amazing about it apparently. She has an interview with a charity on 6 November and is pretty anxious. Remind me to send her a good luck message that morning.
Caroline's dog Biscuit had to be put down on Saturday. She's heartbroken. The kids keep asking where he is.
Ran into Yuki at the station. She and Darius are celebrating their first anniversary on 19 Oct, going back to the restaurant where they had their first date. She asked for a wine recommendation.

Agnieszka's dad's memorial is on the 1st of March, one year since he died. Her mum is finding it really hard. Afterwards the family are having lunch at the Polish club. Need to send Agnieszka a card a few days before.
Gym, then the dentist at 4. Laundry tonight.
Callum update: got a new job!! Starts at the hospital trust on 13 January. Massive relief for him and his wife after the redundancy. Must send congrats.
Farah said Hassan's grandmother is unwell again, back in hospital. They're not sure she'll make it to the wedding. Farah's trying to stay positive but she cried a bit when we talked about it.

Elijah came round. Bit lost after the breakup with Ciara. He's staying at his brother Chris's flat until he finds somewhere. Loves climbing, said he might get back into it. I'll invite him to the bouldering session on Wednesday.

Giulia wants Tanvi, Efua and me as bridesmaids. Dress fitting on 8 March, hen do in Lisbon the weekend of 15/05. Giulia is allergic to shellfish which might be a nightmare in Portugal. Remind me to book flights the day after the fitting once dates are locked.
Mrs Hughes next door told me her son Jin is divorcing. She's very upset, worried about the grandkids.
Phone call with Uncle Delroy. Auntie Barbara's operation went well on Tuesday, she's home now. He's doing all the cooking, which is a first. Call her on Sunday to see how she's feeling.
Darius said his company is shutting the London office at the end of the year. He'll find out on 4 December if he's being kept on or not. Hates the uncertainty.
Anniversary dinner booked for the 22nd, 7:30, the Italian on Mill Lane. I'm picking up flowers that afternoon.
Olivia Wright from work - married to Wiremu, two teenage boys, obsessed with Formula 1. Her eldest just got into Bristol to study engineering.

Efua's nan passed away on Sunday morning. Funeral's set for 3rd of November, then a gathering at her aunt's house afterwards. Efua asked me to do a reading. Need to practise it the week before and send her a message the day after to see how she's holding up.
Hugo and Joanna are renewing their vows on 14 Feb, twenty years. Small thing in the garden. Joanna mentioned she's always wanted a vintage brooch, would make a nice gift.
Tanvi's doing a bit better. The funeral was hard but she said it felt like a proper goodbye. She's going back to work next Monday.
Aurelio's stag is in Dublin 20th-22nd June, wedding 12 July. Santiago is organising, has made a WhatsApp group. Aurelio's fiancée is Mila, they met at uni.

Long chat with Astrid and Zofia over brunch. Zofia's wedding planning is in full swing, she's stressed about the seating plan because her parents are divorced and won't sit together. Astrid is starting a new job at the museum on 2 Jan. I said I'd help Zofia with the favours.
Remind me to call Caroline on Friday. Her mum's funeral is that morning and she said she'd want to talk in the evening.

Yaw's dad was made redundant after 30 years at the plant. Yaw says he's taking it really hard, sits in the garage all day. Their family has a big birthday thing for him on 11/01, his 60th, which might lift his spirits.
Jin and his ex are sharing custody now. He has the kids every other weekend and Wednesdays. Seems happier than he did in the summer.
Note to self: return the cake tins to Wiremu, and drop the card off at Olivia's before the party.

Ciara rang. Says Galway is good for her, she's teaching piano again and her mum is loving having her back. Elijah has been sending her texts which isn't helping. She might come over for Uma's birthday on 26 January.

Agnieszka Morris and Aleksander are expecting! Due in May. Also they're getting married on 30 March before the baby comes, tiny ceremony, just family. She's had awful morning sickness. Should drop round some ginger biscuits.
Darius and Yuki - anniversary went great, he cooked her the full tasting menu from the restaurant at home. Yuki's sister Farah came over for dessert afterwards.

Hassan told me at five a side that his granddad died over the weekend. Funeral is on Thursday 23rd, burial same day. He'll miss the next couple of games. Need to message him after the burial, not before, he said he wants space until then.
Chris and Caroline Baker's golden anniversary is 1st of September. Their daughter Mila is organising a party and wants everyone to write a memory. Don't forget to send mine by 15 August.
Barbara is struggling. Chris still hasn't found work and they've had to cancel the holiday to Tenerife they'd booked for the anniversary.
Wedding RSVP done. Plus one: no. Gift list closes 1/06.

Grabbed lunch with Callum and Uma. Uma's thinking of proposing to her girlfriend Yuki at Christmas. She's got the ring already, hidden in her sock drawer. Callum and I are sworn to help with the plan.

Santiago's parents are celebrating their 40th anniversary in Bogotá on 18 December. He's flying out the week before and staying till New Year. His mum, Mrs Santos, is apparently planning the whole thing like a military operation.
Elijah's grandmother passed away overnight. He's going up to Inverness tomorrow. I should text him the day after the funeral to check he's ok.
Zofia's wedding was beautiful. Carlos cried through the vows. They're off on honeymoon to Mexico from the 20th to the 5th. Must send her the photos I took when they're back.

Afua said her brother Delroy and his partner broke up last month, he's taken it badly. He's been off work with stress. She asked me to keep an eye on him, he trusts me. Text Delroy this weekend, maybe suggest the cinema.
Haircut moved to 10 Nov. Need to sort train tickets for the wedding.

Giulia's dad, Aurelio, is retiring on 31 January after 35 years as a teacher. There's a do at the school that afternoon. Giulia wants to get him a watch from all of us, chipping in fifty each. Remind me to transfer my share the day before.
Joanna Hughes - her interview with the charity went well, second round on 20/11. She's much calmer this time. Her kids are both at secondary now, Uma's school.
Tanvi mentioned her mum keeps asking about the headstone. They've ordered it, should be in place by 14 Feb, his birthday. Tanvi wants us there that morning, small family thing then lunch.
Bumped into Olivia at Tesco. Wiremu's been diagnosed with diabetes, she's overhauling all their cooking. The silver anniversary party is still going ahead.
Met Carlos's sister Mila at the party. Lives in Valencia, works as a vet, mad about salsa dancing. Said if I'm ever in Spain to give her a shout.

Hassan's engaged to Efua! Didn't see that coming. Nikah planned for 6th of April, reception later in the summer. Efua is converting and has been doing classes with Hassan's aunt. Should get them a card this week and congratulate Hassan's mum when I see her on Sunday.

Dinner at Astrid's. Her cat Mochi has a vet operation on Tuesday morning. Aleksander is moving his stuff out the weekend after. Astrid says she's fine about it, just wants it done. Ring her Tuesday evening to see how Mochi got on.
Darius kept his job! Found out on the 4th. Half his team went though, including his manager Barbara. He feels a bit guilty about it.
